date.as_written: śāke candraśaśāṅkakuñjaramite naipālike kārttike || kṛṣṇaikādaśi sattithau ravidine haste ... saṃvat 811 kārttika kṛṣṇa ekādaśī hasta nakṣatre āyuṣmāṃ yoge ādityavāra

notes: The text refers to the date chronogram 'candra-śaśāṅka-kuñjara' (811) in the Nepal era ('naipālike'). King Jayajitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur is credited both with causing the manuscript to be written (ālekhayat) and compiling/preparing the work (dayakā juroṃ).
